contracts.name: Animal domain companion
contracts.publicTest: Cleric3/Inquisitor2 Animal domain supplies one effective5 domain power; apply the domain companion reduction once.

contracts.name: Divine Bond mount
contracts.publicTest: Paladin10->11 applies celestial/type change once; Paladin15 mount SR26; weapon bond does not create mount.

contracts.name: Cavalier mount
contracts.publicTest: Small Cavalier3 ->4 adds boar/dog baseline; death/replacement retains level-dependent benefit delay.

contracts.name: Nature mystery Bonded Mount
contracts.publicTest: Oracle4 Small dog mount: Intelligence at least6; no automatic Cavalier no-share-spells exception.

contracts.name: Witch familiar storage and replacement
contracts.publicTest: Wizard/Witch shared familiar receives one stacked master progression; familiar stores only Witch spells; replacement retains patron bonuses. Preserve the existing unchanged Witch-owned collection across replacement.

contracts.name: Exploiter familiar alternatives
contracts.publicTest: Exploiter Familiar plus Arcane bloodline-development familiar does not double count; alternative choices remain saved.

contracts.name: Original Summoner class-side eidolon interface
contracts.publicTest: Summoner18 diverts5 points -> eidolon cost3; correction10 allows at most2 diverted and no Ability Increase. Twin20 preserves class features and source exceptions.
